card.name: Right after a drug name, before a label
card.fires_on: The word or symbol right after a drug name: an A or C starting AUC or Cmax, a repeated drug name, a letter such as A in cyclosporine A, the end of estradiol, or an opening bracket before an alternate name.

modes.label: AUC or Cmax after drug
modes.description: A single capital letter that starts AUC or Cmax comes right after a drug name.

modes.label: Name ending or alias
modes.description: The final part of a drug name, a repeated name, or a bracket opening an alternate name follows the drug name.

card.plain: It fires on the small piece that follows a drug name, such as the A in AUC or a bracket before a second name.
